capabilities.body: OpenAmer e rulaganya tiro, e e dira ka didirisiwa tsa mmatota — theminale, sebatli, difaele, khoutu — mme e boloka se se dirileng.
capabilities.title: Moemedi yo o akanyang le wena

capabilities.body: Dipuisano, dikgakologelo le dimmotlele di nna mo khomphiutheng eno. Ga go sepe se se romelwang kwa inthaneteng ntle le fa o se kopa.
capabilities.title: Didirisiwa tsa gago, tshedimosetso ya gago

capabilities.body: Dipuo di le 186, nngwe le nngwe ka mokwalo o o o buisang. Sekirini sa ntlha sa porokeramo se botsa gore o batla efe.
capabilities.title: Puo ya gago, ka tshwanelo

capabilities.body: Bokgoni bo bolokwa go tswa mo tirong ka boyone, ka jalo ditiro tsa letsatsi le letsatsi di nna dikhutshwane fa o ntse o e dirisa.
capabilities.title: Bokgoni jo bo golang

help: Netefatsa gore khomphiutha eno e kgona go tsena mo inthaneteng.
Simolola thulaganyo gape — dikgato tse di fedileng ga di boelediwe.
Fa e palelwa gabedi, bula direkoto; mela ya bofelo e supa kgato.
failure.lead: Ga go diphetogo tse di buseditsweng morago ka tidimalo — OpenAmer e ema fa e emisitseng teng, gore fa e tsamaisiwa gape e tswelele go tswa foo.
failure.leadUpdate: OpenAmer e sa ntse e le mo kgatisong ya pele mme e tswelela go dira. Ga go sepe se se emisiseditsweng ka bontlhanngwe.
failure.title: Thulaganyo ga e a fela

language.lead: Thulaganyo e tswelela ka puo e o e tlhophang fano. O ka e fetola moragonyana mo porokeramong.
language.title: Tlhopha puo ya gago

progress.lead: Thulaganyo ya gangwe fela: OpenAmer e kopolola se e se tlhokang mme e baakanya khomphiutha eno. Fa e bulwa gape, e tlola tsotlhe tseno.
progress.leadUpdate: OpenAmer e emisetsa kgatiso ya pele. Ditiragalo tsa gago, dikgakologelo le dithulaganyo ga di fetolwe.
progress.liveOutput: Diphetho tse di tswang ka tlhamalalo
progress.stepsComplete: Go fedile dikgato di le {done} mo go {total}
progress.title: Go rulaganya OpenAmer

stages.bootstrap-marker: Go tshwaya gore go tsenya go fedile
stages.configure: Go rulaganya dikonopo tsa API le dimmotlele
stages.dependencies: Go tsenya diphuthelwana tse Python e di tlhokang
stages.node-deps: Go tsenya diphuthelwana tse Node.js e di tlhokang
stages.platform-sdks: Go tsenya di-SDK tsa diforamo tsa melaetsa
stages.rebuild: Go aga porokeramo ya khomphiutha sesha
stages.repository: Go dira khopi ya bobolokelo jwa OpenAmer
stages.uv: Go tsenya motsamaisi wa diphuthelwana wa uv
stages.venv: Go tlhama tikologo ya Python ya maitirelo

cards.body: Bula porokeramo mme o tlhalose se o batlang se dirwa. OpenAmer e dira kwa morago mme e go begela diphetho.
cards.title: Simolola ka polelo

cards.body: Dithulaganyo → Pontsho → Puo. Ditlhopho tsa puo le kgaolo di le 186, tse o ka di fetolang nako nngwe le nngwe.
cards.title: Tlhopha puo ya gago

cards.body: Tiro e e boelediwang e nna bokgoni — mo nakong e e tlang e tlhoka taelo e le nngwe fela.
cards.title: E letle go gakologelwa

success.command: kgotsa e simolole moragonyana mo theminaleng:
success.errorTitle: Go paletswe go simolola porokeramo ya khomphiutha
success.lead: Dilo tsotlhe di mo maemong a tsone. OpenAmer jaanong ke ya gago — mo khomphiutheng eno, ka puo ya gago.
success.title: OpenAmer e siametse

bullets: E dira mo khomphiutheng ya gago — dipuisano tsa gago di nna mo khomphiutheng eno
Dipuo di le 186, go akaretsa mokwalo o o o buisang
Sengwe le sengwe se ka fetolwa moragonyana; ga go sepe se se nnelang ruri
welcome.lead: Moemedi wa gago. Mo didirisiweng tsa gago. Ka puo ya gago.
welcome.leadUpdate: OpenAmer e ntšhwa e siametse. E emisetsa kgatiso ya pele mme e boloka ditiragalo tsotlhe le dithulaganyo.
welcome.note: Go tsaya metsotso e se kae ka kgolagano e e tlwaelegileng.
welcome.title: O amogetswe mo OpenAmer
